title: Essay
subtitle: 本課限定語境：essay = a relatively short piece of prose writing that develops ideas, arguments, a
description: 本課限定語境：essay = a relatively short piece of prose writing that develops ideas, arguments, analysis, or personal reflection · 「文章／短文／論說文」

words.note: 尤其常見於學校語文課，指學生寫的一篇文章。
words.example: The students wrote a composition about their summer holiday.
words.exampleZh: 學生寫了一篇關於暑假的作文。

exercises.original: The teacher asked the students to write an essay about their summer holiday.
exercises.zh: 老師要求學生寫一篇關於暑假的作文。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher asked the students to write a composition about their summer holiday.

options.explanation: 學校語文寫作語境中，composition 很自然。
也可在較高年級使用，但更有學術／研究作業感。
通常是為出版或媒體讀者寫。
通常要求資料或結構化報告。
只是一段，不是一篇完整文章。

exercises.original: Her English essay described a memorable family trip.
exercises.zh: 她的英文作文描述了一次難忘的家庭旅行。
exercises.upgrade: Her English composition described a memorable family trip.

options.explanation: 語文課中的學生作文最典型。
對這種個人敘述通常過於學術。
需要明確題目／問題回應語境。
篇幅和學術要求完全過高。

exercises.original: The class had forty minutes to complete an essay on friendship.
exercises.zh: 全班有四十分鐘完成一篇關於友誼的作文。
exercises.upgrade: The class had forty minutes to complete a composition on friendship.

options.explanation: 限時課堂寫作非常符合 school composition。
除非題目明確要求敘事，否則不等同 essay。

words.note: 較中性、描述性地指一篇寫成的文字作品。
words.example: The magazine published a short written piece about local history.
words.exampleZh: 雜誌刊登了一篇關於本地歷史的短文。

exercises.original: The magazine published a short essay about the town's history.
exercises.zh: 雜誌刊登了一篇關於小鎮歷史的短文。
exercises.upgrade: The magazine published a short written piece about the town's history.

options.explanation: 中性地描述一篇短篇文字作品。
也非常自然，且更符合雜誌出版語境。

exercises.original: She submitted a reflective essay about her volunteering experience.
exercises.zh: 她提交了一篇關於義工經驗的反思文章。
exercises.upgrade: She submitted a reflective written piece about her volunteering experience.

options.explanation: 可自然涵蓋 reflection 類文章。
若是語文課作文也可能成立，但語氣較學校化。
若是正式課程作業可用，但題句未要求學術研究。

exercises.original: The competition accepts any original essay under two thousand words.
exercises.zh: 比賽接受任何兩千字以下的原創短文。
exercises.upgrade: The competition accepts any original written piece under two thousand words.

options.explanation: 題型未限定學術、媒體或報告文體時很安全。
可能可投稿，但不是所有競賽文章都為媒體出版。

words.meaning: 一篇文章；一段書面作品
words.note: 很自然的廣義表達，表示任何一篇完整文字作品。
words.example: This is one of her strongest pieces of writing.
words.exampleZh: 這是她寫得最好的一篇文章之一。

exercises.original: This essay is one of her strongest works from the course.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章是她在課程中寫得最好的一篇作品之一。
exercises.upgrade: This piece of writing is one of her strongest works from the course.

options.explanation: 最廣泛、中性地指一篇完整文字作品。
若是學術作業可成立，但更窄。

exercises.original: The teacher praised the essay for its clear structure.
exercises.zh: 老師稱讚這篇文章結構清晰。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher praised the piece of writing for its clear structure.

options.explanation: 不需要知道具體文體也成立。

exercises.original: Each essay should show a clear argument and supporting evidence.
exercises.zh: 每篇文章都應有清晰論點和支持證據。
exercises.upgrade: Each piece of writing should show a clear argument and supporting evidence.

options.explanation: 可中性指每一篇完整作品。
敘事為主，不一定有論點。
可能有 evidence，但文體不同。
可以表示作品集合，但 each writings 不合文法。

words.meaning: 論文；課堂文章；書面報告
words.note: 在大學、學校或學術語境中，常指為課程或研究而寫的文章。
words.example: He submitted a ten-page paper on climate policy.
words.exampleZh: 他提交了一篇十頁的氣候政策文章。

exercises.original: He submitted a ten-page essay on climate policy.
exercises.zh: 他提交了一篇十頁的氣候政策文章。
exercises.upgrade: He submitted a ten-page paper on climate policy.

options.explanation: 頁數較長、課程／學術主題，paper 很自然。
若是資料彙報可用，但 essay/paper 更重論證分析。
指行政文件，不是學術文章。

exercises.original: The professor asked for an essay comparing two theories.
exercises.zh: 教授要求寫一篇比較兩種理論的文章。
exercises.upgrade: The professor asked for a paper comparing two theories.

options.explanation: 大學教授＋理論比較是典型學術 paper 語境。
如果只是短答可用，但比較兩種理論通常更完整。
通常呈現結果或資料，不一定論證。

exercises.original: Students must cite at least five sources in the essay.
exercises.zh: 學生必須在文章中引用至少五個資料來源。
exercises.upgrade: Students must cite at least five sources in the paper.

options.explanation: 引用多個來源是學術 paper 的典型特徵。
太廣，沒有突出學術要求。
通常不一定需要正式引用。
可以引用來源，但出版語境未出現。
句子指單篇作業，需單數。

words.note: 泛指以文字完成的作品或作業。
words.example: Students must submit all written work by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 學生必須在星期五前提交所有書面作業。

exercises.original: Students must submit all essays by Friday.
exercises.zh: 學生必須在星期五前提交所有書面作業。
exercises.upgrade: Students must submit all written work by Friday.

options.explanation: 可概括多種書面作業，包括 essays。
也可能成立，但只涵蓋 paper 類作業。
太抽象，不如 written work 明確指作業成果。

exercises.original: Her essays and reports together formed most of her assessed work.
exercises.zh: 她的文章和報告合共構成大部分評核書面作品。
exercises.upgrade: Her essays and reports together formed most of her assessed written work.

options.explanation: 能同時涵蓋 essays 和 reports。
可能涵蓋部分，但範圍不一定足夠。
是寫作風格，不是作品集合。

exercises.original: The portfolio contains essays, reflections, and other written assignments.
exercises.zh: 作品集包括文章、反思文及其他書面作業。
exercises.upgrade: The portfolio contains essays, reflections, and other written work.

words.note: 當 essay 是為雜誌、報紙、網站或其他讀者群寫的較短文章時可接近。
words.example: She wrote an article about the future of public transport.
words.exampleZh: 她寫了一篇關於公共交通未來的文章。

exercises.original: She wrote an essay for a magazine about the future of public transport.
exercises.zh: 她為雜誌寫了一篇關於公共交通未來的文章。
exercises.upgrade: She wrote an article for a magazine about the future of public transport.

options.explanation: for a magazine 是明確出版語境。
若以資料報告為主可用，但題句是一般文章。
需要 prompt/question 回應語境。

exercises.original: The website published his essay on changing work habits.
exercises.zh: 網站刊登了他關於工作習慣轉變的文章。
exercises.upgrade: The website published his article on changing work habits.

options.explanation: 網站公開刊載最自然叫 article。
也可指短篇網上整理，但通常較非正式。
若是調查結果才更合適。

exercises.original: The newspaper invited her to contribute an essay on education.
exercises.zh: 報紙邀請她撰寫一篇教育文章。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper invited her to contribute an article on education.

options.explanation: newspaper + contribute 是典型 article 搭配。
報紙可刊 report，但文體焦點不同。

words.note: 較口語，表示把某件事整理成一篇書面文字。
words.example: He prepared a short write-up of the event.
words.exampleZh: 他為活動準備了一篇簡短書面整理。

exercises.original: He prepared a short essay describing what happened at the event.
exercises.zh: 他準備了一篇簡短文章，描述活動發生的事情。
exercises.upgrade: He prepared a short write-up of the event.

options.explanation: 簡短整理某活動內容，是典型用法。
若準備公開發表也可，但題句只說整理。
也可能，但通常更正式、有結構。

exercises.original: The club posted a brief essay about the competition on its website.
exercises.zh: 學會在網站上刊登了一篇關於比賽的簡短整理。
exercises.upgrade: The club posted a brief write-up about the competition.

options.explanation: club website + brief summary 是很自然的非正式用法。
也合理，但更像正式出版內容。

exercises.original: Please send me a short essay summarizing the meeting.
exercises.zh: 請傳給我一篇簡短的會議書面整理。
exercises.upgrade: Please send me a short write-up summarizing the meeting.

options.explanation: 非正式要求簡短總結最自然。
若需要正式結構可用，但本句只是 short summary。

words.note: 當 essay 是對某個題目、問題或文本作出書面回答時可接近。
words.example: Students must submit a written response to the question.
words.exampleZh: 學生必須就該問題提交書面回答。

exercises.original: Students must write an essay answering the question in Section B.
exercises.zh: 學生必須就 B 部分的問題寫一篇書面回答。
exercises.upgrade: Students must submit a written response to the question in Section B.

options.explanation: 重點是直接回答指定問題。
若篇幅長、學術性高可用，但本句只要求作答。
不合考試／作業題目語境。
可是一篇作文，但沒有突出「回答問題」。

exercises.original: The exam requires a short essay on one of the two prompts.
exercises.zh: 考試要求就兩個題目其中之一寫一篇短答文章。
exercises.upgrade: The exam requires a short written response to one of the two prompts.

options.explanation: exam + prompt 強烈支持 response。
通常不會用於短時間考試作答。

exercises.original: Her essay directly addressed every part of the assignment question.
exercises.zh: 她的書面回答直接處理了作業問題的每一部分。
exercises.upgrade: Her written response directly addressed every part of the assignment question.

options.explanation: 直接回應 assignment question 是核心。
可以是作業，但不特別突出 response function。
也可能成立，但更學術、較長。

words.meaning: 作文；題目作文（較舊式／傳統用法）
words.note: 在較舊式或部分學校英語中，theme 可指學生按題目寫的作文。
words.example: The teacher asked the class to write a theme on friendship.
words.exampleZh: 老師要求全班寫一篇關於友誼的作文。

exercises.original: In an older school textbook, students were asked to write an essay on honesty.
exercises.zh: 在一本較舊的學校課本中，學生被要求寫一篇關於誠實的作文。
exercises.upgrade: Students were asked to write a theme on honesty.

options.explanation: 在較舊式學校英語中，可表示按題目寫的作文。
現代也很自然，甚至更常見。

exercises.original: The teacher assigned an essay titled “A Day I Will Never Forget.”
exercises.zh: 老師指定了一篇題為「我永不忘記的一天」的作文。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher assigned a theme titled “A Day I Will Never Forget.”

options.explanation: 帶傳統學校作文題目的語感。
現代更常見，也非常接近。
若是回應 prompt 可理解，但不如 theme 的舊式作文義。

exercises.original: The phrase “write a theme” was once commonly used for school essays.
exercises.zh: 「write a theme」過去曾常用來表示寫學校作文。
exercises.upgrade: The phrase “write a theme” was once commonly used for school essays.

options.explanation: 這題專門測較舊式的 school essay 用法。
是另一種現代學術用語。

falseSynonyms.zh: 報告 ≠ 一般 essay report 通常有較明確結構、資料、結果或建議。 essay 更常發展論點、分析或反思。
高度相關，但通常有出版語境 article 常為報紙、雜誌、網站等讀者而寫。 課堂 essay 不一定是 article。
學位論文 ≠ 普通 essay dissertation 通常長得多、研究要求更高。
論文／論點 ≠ 普通 essay thesis 可指： - 學位論文 - 一篇文章的中心論點 都不等於一般 essay。
故事 ≠ 論說／分析文章 story 以敘事為核心。 essay 可以是敘事性，但更多時是分析或論證。
段落 ≠ 一篇 essay paragraph 只是文章的一部分。
詞形陷阱 - essay = 文章；短文 - essayist = 散文家／隨筆作家
詞形不同 - write = 動詞 - writing = 名詞／動名詞 - written = 過去分詞／形容詞
